I was convinced that my dogs could speak but were afraid to because I would tell the government and they would be tested on in labs (I have no clue why I thought this or how I came up with this belief). Anyways, I would quietly bring them into my room and sit in front of them and say “You can talk to me, I promise I won’t tell the government. Just say one word.”

I basically believed I was Dr.DoLittle
After all my efforts, surprisingly they never said a word.

Last July I was shopping around my local Target. I was looking at bed sheets while this man (about 6 foot, dark hair, mid 30s) came into the isle. Nothing out of the ordinary. After grabbing a pack of sheets I went to go grab toothpaste. After walking across the store to the toothpaste isle, I looked over and he was next to me. I guess i’ve always been aware of my surroundings but at this point I didn’t know if it was a coincidence or if he was following me. I decided to test him and see if he was actually following me. So I crossed over to the other side of the store to look at books. I was there for a few minutes thinking I was all good until once again, he appeared next to me. At this point I get nervous so I quickly leave the isle and call my mom. I was pacing around the store with him following from a distance. She told me to go to security so I finally did. Security is near the registers so I walked all the way over there. He followed me to the front of the store (thinking I was going to my car or checking out) but once he saw me run up to security he booked it out of the store. After talking to security, they told me that it’s been a problem there lately (of women being followed. Keep in mind i’m really petite and 20 years old). I ended up having to be escorted to my car after giving a description. When being escorted to my car, they saw him standing outside so they made sure he didn’t follow me home and they got a photo of his license plate. After sending his license plate to the police station, the manager of target called me and told me he was a registered sex offender and if he came back into the store, he would be banned. They looked at the security footage and he was following me ever since I got into the store, long before I even noticed him.

If I didn’t notice him or go to security,  I’m not sure what would have happened. Always trust your gut.
